# A box's justifyContent on gtk4, and flex weights other than even.
#
# A GtkBox packs its children from the start and splits its spare room evenly
# between the ones that expand, so each pair below drew the same picture: a
# row justified to its end as one packed at its start, and children flexing
# 1 and 3 as children flexing 1 and 1. gtk4rt lays such a box out itself
# now; pkg/go/gtk4rt/flex_test.go measures where it puts each child.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/packed.png app.sngl.snapshots/justified.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/even.png app.sngl.snapshots/weighted.png

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output { go { gtk4 } }

component packed ui.node {
    ui.hbox(style={width=300px}) {
        ui.text(value="a")
        ui.text(value="b")
    }
}

component justified ui.node {
    ui.hbox(style={width=300px, justifyContent=end}) {
        ui.text(value="a")
        ui.text(value="b")
    }
}

component even ui.node {
    ui.hbox(style={width=300px}) {
        ui.text(value="a", style={flex=1.0, background=#336699})
        ui.text(value="b", style={flex=1.0, background=#993366})
    }
}

component weighted ui.node {
    ui.hbox(style={width=300px}) {
        ui.text(value="a", style={flex=1.0, background=#336699})
        ui.text(value="b", style={flex=3.0, background=#993366})
    }
}

func testPacked(t test.Test, c packed) {
    t.snapshot("packed")
}

func testJustified(t test.Test, c justified) {
    t.snapshot("justified")
}

func testEven(t test.Test, c even) {
    t.snapshot("even")
}

func testWeighted(t test.Test, c weighted) {
    t.snapshot("weighted")
}

ui.window {
    packed
}
